selection.reason: No eligible Bundesliga or Champions League match today; next uncovered top match is Arsenal–Dortmund on 24 November, with a verifiable returning former Arsenal player.

research.verified_context: BVB official profile states Nwaneri joined Arsenal's academy aged eight and played for the Arsenal first team before joining Dortmund on 1 September 2026; Arsenal lists Saka as current first-team player.

story.creative_goal: immediate surprising moment with comprehensible visual payoff

candidate_concepts.idea: Nwaneri returns in Dortmund shirt inside oversized Arsenal-red vending machine while Saka tries to get a drink
candidate_concepts.reason: One clear impossible situation, both recognizable players visible immediately and former Arsenal player is the unexpected return.

candidate_concepts.idea: An old Arsenal framed photo unexpectedly winks at Nwaneri
candidate_concepts.rejected: Requires duplicate faces and makes the two-player gag hard to read in five seconds.

candidate_concepts.idea: An Arsenal jersey turns into a Dortmund jersey
candidate_concepts.rejected: Repeats moving-clothes motif from 21 November and generated transformations risk inconsistencies.

story.setting_difference: open lobby vending machine with a person unexpectedly inside; no bus or luggage
story.unexpected_visual: Former Arsenal player Nwaneri stands inside a giant vending machine in a Dortmund shirt.
story.first_second_hook: Both faces and Nwaneri visible behind the partly open transparent machine door immediately.
story.payoff: Saka opens the machine, Nwaneri steps out and both smile.
story.football_context_connection: Nwaneri was Arsenal's academy player and is now at Dortmund facing his former club.
story.visual_retell_test: Saka entdeckt seinen früheren Arsenal-Mitspieler Nwaneri im BVB-Trikot in einem Getränkeautomaten.

qa.surprise_review: Nwaneri-like BVB player visible inside red drink machine from opening, Saka-like Arsenal player presses button, machine opens and player steps out, both smile. The visual joke works without dialogue.
qa.player_review: Both characters broadly resemble official player references in sampled frames; Dortmund yellow and Arsenal red-white kits are visible. Identity similarity is approximate.
qa.setting_review: fictional indoor lounge, no real pitch
qa.audio_review: AAC track present and source audio packets identical; generated German wording, naturalness and lip sync not independently heard. No unquoted paid analysis ordered.
qa.outro_review: Two-second rendition of verified German master; logo, domain and exact German disclaimer visible.

english_commentary.handoff_review: Completed voice node inspected, but connector did not expose the generated audio URL through the available non-polling asset lookup; no video mix/export performed.
